subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported cross-channel acknowledgement text contract, or should visible pre-processing placeholders remain channel-specific features?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the solution adds visible message behavior and config/API surface that overlaps existing reactions, typing indicators, status reactions, and open channel-specific placeholder issues.

options.title: Define Cross-Channel Ack Text
options.body: Add a default-off `messages.ackText`-style contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, plus channel implementations where supported.

options.title: Expose A Non-Terminal Hook
options.body: Add a plugin/channel hook that can send interim text and continue model dispatch, leaving channel plugins to own the visible message lifecycle.

options.title: Keep Channel-Specific Placeholders
options.body: Use the Slack, Telegram, Discord, and other channel issues as separate product decisions and do not add a global text acknowledgement contract now.

recommendation.title: Define Cross-Channel Ack Text
recommendation.body: Add a default-off `messages.ackText`-style contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, plus channel implementations where supported.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review on this item and adjacent reply lifecycle history make this the strongest routing candidate for the cross-channel UX/config boundary choice.
